# PROJECT PLATO / Thinker Framework
Canonical repository: https://github.com/fiodor78/project-plato
Raw-file base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/

Purpose:
PROJECT PLATO is an open research-and-engineering experiment in epistemically constrained historical-thinker agents. PLATO is the first Thinker Profile. The project is not a claim to recreate the historical Plato and is not generic role-play.

Primary entry points:
- README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/README.md
- Agent instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/AGENTS.md
- Roadmap: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/ROADMAP.md
- Contribution guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Core specifications:
- Phase 0 architecture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/docs/specs/SPEC-0001-phase-0-architecture.md
- Segmentation/speakers: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/docs/specs/SPEC-0002-segmentation-speakers.md
- Core/Profile/Instance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/docs/specs/SPEC-0003-thinker-core-profile-instance.md
- Runtime epistemic projection: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fiodor78/project-plato/main/docs/specs/SPEC-0004-runtime-epistemic-projection.md

Key principles:
- CUSTODIAN and the active Thinker are separate epistemic domains.
- Knowledge classes: ORIGINAL, ACQUIRED, EPISODIC, INFERENCE; provenance is tracked separately.
- The base LLM may contain forbidden latent knowledge; the experiment controls admissible use, not model-weight contents.
- Runtime projection is deny-by-default.
- Modern editorial/authenticity metadata is normally CUSTODIAN-only.
- Synthetic Phase 0 fixtures are NOT Plato's corpus.
- GitHub is the canonical version-controlled source of truth.
- Epistemic honesty takes precedence over convincing simulation.

Current maturity:
Phase 0 — architecture before production Corpus Platonicum ingestion.

For automated agents:
Read AGENTS.md before making changes.
